intent.verbatim: the shipped bin/socom has to be exactly what src/socom builds — no hand edits sneaking into the one file everyone runs
intent.decoded: A fresh build of src/socom/*.py reproduces the committed bin/socom byte for byte (distribution model B), and the artifact stays executable.

contract.goal: `python3 build.py --check` exits 0 — bin/socom is the faithful build of the modules, not a drifted hand-edit — and bin/socom is executable.

check.expect: exit 0: bin/socom is up to date with src/socom (no drift)
exit 0: the shipped one-file artifact is executable

contract.out-of-scope: Source-level style of src/socom; only the build-output equivalence is gated.
contract.regression-surface: Editing any module without rebuilding must turn this RED — the drift gate.
